        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Transition: From Spheres to Necklaces", ["Now, let's talk about necklaces.", "Two thieves want a fair share.", "Can we cut fairly with beads?"])
        
        # Colors
        c_gold = "#FFD700"
        c_silver = "#C0C0C0"
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(BLUE))

            color = c_gold if i < 10 else c_silver
            bead = Dot(radius=0.15, color=color)
            beads.add(bead)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(RED))
        cut_line = Line(start=UP*0.5, end=DOWN*0.5, color=RED).rotate(PI/4)
